ccadical_solver_used_for: solve only (proofs are checked by drat-trim)

procedure.check: drat-trim input.cnf proof.drat (text DRAT, no flag); verdict VERIFIED iff stdout contains 's VERIFIED' and exit code is 0
procedure.cnf: parabola_half_bound.clauses_for_pair(2207, edges, d); edges from $TEMP/p2207_drat/edges_2207.txt, sha256 d1eb1385...
procedure.receipt: one atomic JSON receipt per d plus an aggregate atomic JSON; a d with a VERIFIED receipt and a matching proof.drat.gz sha256 is skipped on re-run
procedure.solve_fallback: native CaDiCaL (proof written straight to disk, no RAM retention) --binary=false text DRAT, exit 20=UNSAT/10=SAT/0=UNKNOWN; used when MemAvailable is below the floor, on MemoryError, or for --native-ds
procedure.solve_main: pysat Cadical195(bootstrap_with=clauses, with_proof=True).solve_limited() with the conflict budget ladder; proof text captured in RAM then written to proof.drat (discarded after gzip), gzip mtime=0
procedure.target: K0693 (p=2207 equality A(p)=(p+3)/2 not attained), full DRAT audit of all d=1..1103 UNSAT claims following the W26 design (research/log/2026-11-12-p2207-full-audit-design-omp.md)
